tool_args.rationale: The pilot is confined to H ≤ 0.48, while the target horizon is 21.6. A slow-horizon probe directly resolves the consequential timescale and mechanism ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify both timescales or constrain the long-horizon adaptation at H = 21.6.
Fine short-window measurements would be less directly informative about the slow horizon and possible reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon reversal and periodic Lotka–Volterra models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short pilot does not adequately distinguish their long-horizon behavior from the sink-coupled adaptation candidate.
